reason: A brand-new store has zero Google Maps reviews on opening day, and I don't try a place until I've read what other women say about the fit, the fabric and the staff. There's no Eid or wedding coming up for me this month either, so nothing is pushing me to go in early for 15% off.
objection: I can't tell from the racks whether it's my style. Embroidered thobes, jalabiyas and bishts read very Gulf to me, and a $45 everyday abaya could be just another plain black one I already own. Without reviews or real photos I'm not driving to Westchase to find out.
would_change_my_mind: A few months of solid Google Maps reviews with customer photos showing modern, less traditional cuts, or a friend from the masjid wearing something from there that I actually like.
